citations.evidenceText: AE-05 applies outside the College of Medicine and Health Sciences. For undergraduates, good standing requires CGPA at least 2.00. After studying 21 credits, CGPA below 2.00 at semester end gives first probation. First or second probation normally permits the next regular semester with no more than 13 credits; CGPA must rise to at least 2.00 in the next semester for good standing. Remaining below 2.00 after first probation gives second probation. Procedure 2(e): remaining below 2.00 after second probation gives third academic probation AND academic dismissal, not alternative outcomes. Procedure 2(f) is a specific exception: third-probation CGPA at least 1.80 AND expected graduation within one academic year gives one semester to reach 2.00; failure then gives fourth probation AND dismissal. Summer is excluded from probation-period counting. Procedure 2(h) separately permits more than 13 credits when course evaluation has raised the CGPA; do not generalize that exception to every probation case. Official standing is in the student information system and notices are by university email. Published effective date: 12 August 2018, review due 1 September 2021; later supersession is not established. The assistant has not accessed an individual's standing or certified exception eligibility.

An Academic Grievance at UAEU is when a student claims mistreatment or unfair treatment in an academic or enrollment matter.

An Academic Appeal is when a student claims an incorrect or erroneous application of a University Academic Policy or requests an exception to such a policy.

citations.title: UAEU AE-09 Student Academic Grievances and Appeals
citations.sourceSection: Procedures1 Definitions;2 SAGAC
citations.evidenceText: Under the published UAEU AE-09 Student Academic Grievances and Appeals procedures, effective12August2018, an Academic Grievance is a student claim of mistreatment or unfair treatment in an academic or enrollment matter. An Academic Appeal is a claim of incorrect or erroneous application of a University Academic Policy, or a request for an exception to such a policy. payload.content:
For admission to UAEU master's programs taught predominantly in English, applicants need a related accredited bachelor's degree, a minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale or equivalent, and an IELTS Academic score of at least 6.0 or an equivalent language test not older than two years, with some exemptions for native speakers or English-medium education.

Applicants with a bachelor's GPA between 2.5 and below 3.0 may be admitted conditionally, allowing up to 9 credit hours in the first semester and requiring a GPA of 3.0 in those courses to continue; a GPA of 2.7 does not automatically reject or guarantee admission.

For IELTS, a conditional admission route exists for applicants scoring 5.5, who must then achieve an IELTS of 6.0 by the end of the first semester, take no more than 6 credit hours initially (excluding intensive English), and earn a GPA of 3.0 in the first 9 credit hours to maintain admission.
